name: Sakurai Mako
source:
A veteran clerk at the antique coffee shop "Curio", Mako is usually in charge of the main floor. She is kind and gentle, but also very air-headed, so she tends to make mistakes in the customers' orders and gets easily deceived by people. Mako also has a maternal instinct and is not afraid of strangers' babies and stray cats. Currently her family lives in a foreign country, so Mako lives alone. Surprisingly enough she likes professional wrestling.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E3%82%B7%E3%83%A7%E3%82%B3%E3%83%A9_%E3%80%9Cmaid_cafe_%22curio%22%E3%80%9C]Wikipedia[/url].]
